title: Jelly Buttons
description: Buttons made of jelly: they squash on the press, overshoot on the release, and wobble home.
usage: An elastic timing curve and a squish keyframe turn the most serious control on the page into dessert. Use it where the brand is allowed to grin — a game, a toy, a checkout that just succeeded. Keep it away from the delete button; some actions should feel like actions.
a11y: The jelly is transform-only: size, name, focus and order are untouched, and the keyboard press is as dignified as any other button. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wobble is off and the buttons are, sadly, professional.
